subject: post
title: POST.------AFL.DY.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 63 (WAM-5). POST (postulation) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: AFI (affinity insight) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From AFI: ATTC (attachment). From ATTC: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From MT-INFO: CRFT-D and STF (source transfer). From CRFT-D: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From PROG-CONT: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics).
